Research notes on WordNet ego-network extraction and sharded growformer training.

Available notes:
- Cairn Architecture: Spec draft: narrow agents (tagger, summarizer, linker) backed by micro-brains.
- WordNet Training: Research notes on WordNet ego-network extraction and sharded growformer training.
- Auto-Tag Integration: TODO: wire spacekit agent infer into Cairn tagger adapter instead of mock heuristics.
- Lookup Graph Fallback: Architecture sketch — lookup_graph fast path for single-token wordnet queries.
- Daily Journal: Daily journal — tired but finished the wordnet lookup graph fallback path.
- Design Wiki Links: Meeting with design on [[Cairn]] wiki links — need auto-tag before publish.
- Linker Feature Idea: Feature idea: suggest links between notes using token overlap + growformer ranker.
- Performance Bug: Bug: infer reloads full brain every CLI call; use agent load for warm path.
- Sprint Roadmap: Sprint planning — prioritize summarizer brain after tagger ships.
- Security Review: Security review — ensure infer with local brain skips storage node when entitled.
- Client Export: Client call recap — they want export to markdown with preserved [[wiki-links]].
- Interview Prep: Interview prep — system design for note graphs, backlinks, and semantic search.
- Training Retro: Retro: batch train.sh doesn't resume; document manual shard merge steps.
- Micro-Brain Blog: Published blog post on building micro-brains instead of calling external LLM APIs.
- Welcome to Cairn: This notes app runs on the Spacekit network with narrow agents for tag, summarize, and links.
